correctness.rationale: PASS: Coxeter length in a direct product is additive in factor projections. If a literal palindrome draws letters outside its central factor, one projection is a nonempty even palindrome and has equal adjacent middle letters, hence is nonreduced. Therefore the language is exactly the union of odd alternating single-factor words, bounded by M_i for finite factors. A total DFA has one start and one rejecting sink, four orientation/parity continuation states per infinite factor, 2(M_i−1) proper-prefix states per finite factor and one shared finite terminal accepting state. Myhill–Nerode distinguishes all remaining right contexts by maximum accepted suffix length, next generator, parity, and factor alphabet, giving matching lower bound. Fresh independent residual-state calculations corroborated seven finite parameter configurations and the six-state infinite dihedral case. Infinite/all-parameter proof is not inferred from finite tests.
